title: Bridge Marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: At Bridge Marina, we don’t just rent boats; we help create unforgettable boating experiences on Lake Hopatcong and Sandy Hook Bay. Our boat rental fleet is designed with one goal in mind: making your time on the water effortless, safe, and filled with memories. Check out our video walk through below to see just one of the beautiful boats we rent on Lake Hopatcong and in Highlands! Our rental lineup features Starcraft Marine triple pontoon boats, widely recognized for their stability, comfort, and performance. Each boat in our fleet has been specifically chosen to handle local lake and coastal conditions, giving you the confidence to explore with ease. With plush seating for up to 10
